package.name: tops_description
package.description: The TOPS robot model: the real Franka Emika Panda with the Franka Hand. Kinematics, joint limits, inertials and joint dynamics are Franka's official data (config/franka/, copied verbatim from franka_description); the meshes are the real Panda geometry with PBR textures (meshes/). Adds a wrist force/torque measurement, a fixed RGB-D camera, and the ros2_control contract that exposes effort command interfaces on all seven joints.
